purpose: Provider-independent, provenance-bearing company-page facts without changing ranking contracts.

classification_policy.official: NSE/BSE or issuer evidence retained verbatim with source
classification_policy.professor: Separate workbook evidence used only for professor-method reproduction
classification_policy.derived_research: Allowed only from reproducible business evidence; company-name guessing and opaque prediction are forbidden

secondary_reference: identity-validated Yahoo Finance observations through isolated yfinance acquisition
user-supplied Screener Premium market-wide exports accepted for current/reference enrichment with explicit provenance
fundamentals: user-supplied Screener Premium exports/workbooks for current/reference display and analysis only
ownership: user-supplied Screener Premium exports/workbooks for current/reference ownership display only

scientific_boundaries: No missing fact is guessed or imputed.
User-supplied Screener Premium exports/workbooks may populate current/reference facts only when their provenance and identity match are retained.
Standalone and consolidated facts are never silently mixed.
Page completeness is independent of Baseline and Research V2 eligibility.
Screener.in is not a runtime dependency; no automated provider request occurs during page navigation.
Screener current/reference facts never create, backdate or overwrite historical PIT evidence.
Research V2 PIT factors and eligibility remain based on accepted official filing evidence plus official exchange dissemination/availability timing.
Secondary reference fields never override official identity or frozen Research V2 PIT inputs.
Every secondary row must satisfy its provider-specific identity checks before contributing facts; conflicts and quarantined identities are rejected.

screener_current_reference_policy.acquisition: No runtime scraping, crawling, browser automation, API request or provider request during page navigation.
screener_current_reference_policy.accepted_input: User-supplied/manual Screener Premium exports and workbooks may enter the current/reference company-fact layer with explicit provenance.
screener_current_reference_policy.precedence: Exact canonical ISIN is primary. A unique accepted primary-exchange security-code match may be used only as a current/reference identity fallback; quarantined/conflicting identities are rejected.
screener_current_reference_policy.source_precedence: For overlapping current/reference fields, the accepted Snapshot export is preferred and Operational is fallback; original provider observations remain provenance-bearing.
screener_current_reference_policy.pit_boundary: Screener current/reference observations are never backdated, promoted or treated as historical point-in-time evidence.
screener_current_reference_policy.research_v2_boundary: Research V2 PIT eligibility and ranking inputs remain frozen to accepted official filing evidence and official exchange dissemination/availability clocks.
